verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents a Slack channel monitor: you @mention openhands, it opens an agent conversation with the message context and replies when the agent finishes. That covers tagging and delegating a task from a chat thread. Two-way discussion inside the thread is not documented; it is framed as an automation template that posts a single reply on completion. Missing for 10: documented multi-turn back-and-forth in the chat thread, chat platforms beyond Slack, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can tag an agent in a chat thread to discuss and delegate a bug or task

citations.quote: Watch Slack channels for @openhands mentions, open a conversation with the message context, and reply when the agent finishes.
